snippet_primary: "Although we display your products in one of the many currencies we offer, ultimately we charge your customers the equivalent cost in USD. We do this using real-time, mid-market exchange rates to convert purchases to USD for processing. We do not charge any additional fees for this conversion."
subject_exact: Lemon Squeezy charges customers in USD equivalent using real-time mid-market rates regardless of displayed currency; no additional currency conversion fees charged
